description: Ministry of University Education & Highways - Order made under Section 20(4) Appointment of Prof. Uma Coomarasamy to be the Competent Authority - Eastern University, Sri Lanka by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella
categorisation: This gazette names a specific individual (Prof. Uma Coomarasamy) and details their appointment as Competent Authority with specific powers and functions (exercising powers in lieu of the Vice-Chancellor, performing duties conferred by the Universities Act and related regulations). It contains both the "who" (government person) and "what" (detailed responsibilities/portfolios), making it a Hybrid Gazette.
